metadata.collection: public HTTP requests + Scrapling 0.5 HTML parser; no browser window, API key, credits or billing
limitations: Editorial coverage is a discovery signal, not proof of current virality or current opening status.
Publication dates span 2021–2026; retrieval in 2026 does not make the coverage current.
Google ratings, reviews, coordinates, live hours, prices and halal status remain unknown.
Photo URLs are source references, not downloaded or cleared for app reuse.
Maps search links are generated from the name and address; exact Google branches have not been matched.
Research is not imported into the 37 published app records.
